# The Drop · Week 9 — Season 2
**Setup:** Admin → sidebar working season = **Season 2** → The Drop → edition dropdown = **Week 9** → **+ New edition**.

## 1 · Header fields
### Kicker
```
The Drop · Week 9
```
### Byline
```
By The Society Desk
```
### Lead headline
```
Week Nine: The Fixture Team Wins a Match Nobody Timed Correctly
```
### Dek (sub-headline)
```
A test headline, a test dek, and a sub-headline label that also contains the word headline.
```

## 2 · Lead story
Paste the whole box into the Lead story editor in one go. Blank lines become paragraphs; a line starting with "> " becomes the pull-quote.
```
Alpha Squad dressed six players on Thursday and all six went 4–0. That adds up to twelve games in about 88 minutes, the shortest match of the night, and the second clean sheet of this imaginary season so far.

The strangest result was on the far courts, where Bravo Club outscored Charlie Crew by thirteen points and still lost 3–1. Seven of the twelve games were decided by three or fewer, and Charlie Crew won six of them.

> One team was outscored by 13 and won 3–1. Wide open has a sense of humor.

Standings after nine weeks: Alpha Squad 14–2, Bravo Club 10–6, Charlie Crew 9–7. **Both** jerseys go to Alpha Squad this week. If you're reading this… you're officially invited to the happy hour.
```

## 3 · Around the League
One box, one paste, into the Around the League textarea. One line per team, format "Team Name :: blurb". Do not split them up.
```
Alpha Squad :: Six dressed, six went 4–0, and the match took about 88 minutes. Storyline below.
Bravo Club :: 115 points and a 1–3 loss: 1–6 in close games a week after going 4–0 in them. Storyline below.
Charlie Crew :: Outscored 115–102, won 3–1, and went from fifth to third. Storyline below.
```

## 4 · Storylines
Click + Add storyline once per storyline. Type is a dropdown; the other four are paste boxes. Set the **Team** type-to-find box on each team storyline so the Breakdown card renders under it; leave it blank on any non-team storyline.

### Storyline 1
**Type (dropdown):** `title`
**Team (type-to-find):** `Alpha Squad`
**Tag**
```
Four clear
```
**Headline**
```
Alpha Squad: six players, six 4–0 nights
```
**Body**
```
Alpha Squad gave six players four games each and every one of them went 4–0, which is the kind of sentence a fixture file can write without checking.

**Mixed is no longer the question.** They were 7–9 in mixed after two weeks and are 15–1 since, with the women's slot unbeaten across the same stretch.
```
**Chips** (one field, exactly as written)
```
Match: 4–0 · games 12–0 · 88 min, Mixed: 8–0 · 15–1 last two weeks, Weekly podiums: all six spots
```
